description: START of the '$100 → $120' journey after the principles: record what the user is into (tapped chips or typed words) and map each interest to the backtest-ranked tradable themes. Returns the matched themes with their measured numbers and the next question. Works for anonymous users. (no key needed)

asset_class.description: Stocks, crypto, or both (the user's choice; one class = one vehicle).

conversation_id.description: conversation_id returned by an earlier theme_journey_* call (keeps an anonymous visitor's interests and basket together until they register).

interests.description: What the user said they are into, e.g. ['space', 'AI power demand'].

name: theme_journey_interests
title: Theme Journey Interests
